greeting.speaker: the Timeless One
text: Four hundred names on that board. I have watched every one of them go up and most of them come down. Ask me quickly; I lose the thread of a century easily.
Sit, or do not. I have seen both, and the difference took two hundred years to stop mattering to me.
You are new. Everything in this hall is new except the floor and the thing under it.

options.text: How long have you been in this hall?
What was here before the keep?
Does any of it stay with you? Any one of the four hundred?
You aren't remembering the past. You're reading it off the board like the rest of us.
Then tell me something worth carrying out of here.

again.speaker: the Timeless One
text: You. I have put you on the board in pencil. Do not take it personally; everyone begins in pencil.
Back. Good. Companies that come back are the only ones I bother learning the names of.
Something has changed in you since the last time and I cannot tell whether it is the armour.

options.text: What have you remembered since we left?
The gate under the floor. Why did that one stay shut?
Tell me something worth carrying out of here.

how_long.speaker: the Timeless One
how_long.text: Long enough that the question stopped being interesting and started being rude. Longer than the walls. Not longer than the thorn.

before.speaker: the Timeless One
before.text: A gate. Not one of yours — one that stayed shut. Somebody built a keep on top of it, which is either the wisest or the stupidest thing anyone has done in this country.

the_admission.speaker: the Timeless One
the_admission.text: ...Yes. I forget in the order it happened, so I keep the board. But I remember the gate under the floor without looking, and you should ask yourself why that one stayed.

the_deflection.speaker: the Timeless One
the_deflection.text: Everyone reads. Not everyone remembers what the reading is for.

the_gift.speaker: the Timeless One
the_gift.text: Every company that held this hall did it by deciding early who was worth losing. The ones that decided late lost everyone. Decide early. Then prove yourself wrong.

the_one_kept.speaker: the Timeless One
the_one_kept.text: One. A girl who carried water and was never on the board at all. I could not tell you a single captain's face, and I could draw hers.

remembered_since.speaker: the Timeless One
text: That the thorn was planted, not grown. Somebody wanted this place hard to reach.
A winter I had mislaid. Nothing happened in it. That is why I mislaid it.
Your name, which is new, and which I have not had to look up. Take that as you find it.

why_it_stayed.speaker: the Timeless One
why_it_stayed.text: Because it was shut from this side, by people who then built a house on it and lived there so no one would be tempted. Every gate since has been opened by somebody who thought they were the first.
